data.name: Ramiz
data.gender_notes: Ramiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is exalted, noble, precious and is worthy of reverence. The name Ramiz carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble, Precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ramiz usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a soul that is elevated and enlightened
data.etymology: Ramiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble, Precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramiz total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رامز
in_arabic.meaning: رامز يعني الشخص الذي يرمز أو يشير إلى شيء ما
in_arabic.long_meaning: رامز هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني الشخص الذي يرمز أو يشير إلى شيء ما، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "ورمزا إليه بالسكين". يعتبر اسم رامز من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة ومتجذرة في اللغة العربية والتراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: رامز
in_urdu.meaning: رامز کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی چیز کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رامز ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی چیز کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے یا اس کا رمز ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشرے میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، جہاں اس کی اہمیت اسلامی تراث سے منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रामज़
in_hindi.meaning: रामज़ का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो किसी चीज़ की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रामज़ एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो किसी चीज़ की ओर संकेत करता है या उसका चिह्न होता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रयोग होता है, जहां इसकी महत्ता इस्लामी परंपरा से जुड़ी हुई है।

in_pashto.name: رامز
in_pashto.meaning: رامز دى هغه چا چې کوم څه ته اشاره کوي

in_english.name: Ramiz
in_english.meaning: Ramiz means one who gives a signal or makes a gesture
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ramiz originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the root 'R-M-Z', which means to signal, indicate, or gesture. This name is found in various Muslim cultures and is often associated with qualities of leadership, communication, and subtlety. In Islamic tradition, the name Ramiz holds significance for its reference to conveying messages or signs. Historically, individuals bearing this name have been noted for their ability to inspire and guide others through their actions and gestures.
